subject: Streaming responses hanging during peak traffic — urgent customer escalation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@oregonretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@oregonretail.com, SRE Team <sre@oregonretail.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Hi Rafael,

We started seeing repeated hangs in the streaming responses for our checkout assistant around 07:50 PT this morning. The UI shows the spinner and partial tokens for 40–60s, then either a 504 or an empty close. Latency and error rate spiked (we pushed a traffic surge around 07:45 for a promo). This is affecting conversion — we have customers seeing stalled autocomplete and help messages.

Attached is a small dump from our frontend (live-logs-2027-09-08-07-58.txt) and a screenshot of the spinner state. We used the public Redwood endpoint via our normal API key.

Can you route this to engineering ASAP? We need a short timeline: is there a known fallback we can switch to while you investigate (lower-throughput model, different endpoint, etc.)?

Thanks — this is high priority for our ops and revenue teams.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product — Oregon Retail
liam@oregonretail.com
+1 503-555-0119

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@oregonretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Liam —

Thanks for the quick report and the logs. I’m escalating to our SRE/Realtime team right now (marissa and aditya looped). Immediate mitigation suggestions below while we triage:
- Switch the route to the synchronous endpoint (non-streaming) for critical checkout flows — that will increase token cost but avoids chunked transfer timeouts.
- Temporarily pin to model-redwood-compact v2 (lower concurrency per worker) — we can programmatically route for a 15–30 minute window.
- Disable client-side aggressive reconnects for 2 minutes so we don’t amplify retries.

Marissa/Aditya — can you confirm ETA for a root-cause check and whether we have a rolling workaround (proxy config or kernel toggle) we can flip from the console? I’ll put this up to exec if it looks like a platform-level regression.

Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

On Wed, Sep 8, 2027 at 8:25 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa/Aditya — can you confirm ETA for a root-cause check and whether we have a rolling workaround (proxy config or kernel toggle) we can flip from the console?

We’re seeing an increase in timed-out chunk deliveries on the regional routing tier that correlates to a CPU saturation event on a subset of proxy hosts. Error rate spikes align with a surge pattern from 07:44–08:02 PT. Initial triage:
- Symptoms: intermittent token drops and long inter-chunk latency (30–90s).
- Probable immediate cause: proxy-level backpressure + continuous-batching interactions causing head-of-line stalls under bursty small-request workloads.

Immediate actions taken (08:35–08:38 PT):
- Scaled proxy pool + increased per-host chunk buffer sizes (temporary).
- Enabled an emergency routing rule to divert 25% of OR traffic to a dedicated low-latency pool (this should reduce contention).

I’ll keep this thread updated with metrics and logs in the next 20 minutes. If those mitigations hold, we can recommend Rafael's suggested pinning or sync fallback for the customer.

— Marissa
Senior Realtime SRE | Redwood Inference
Attachment: screenshot-stream-hang.png (image/png)

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Quick technical note from the runtime side:
- We observed elevated sysload on the kernel selector service for region-us-west-2 between 07:42–07:58 PT. Some worker processes entered a busy loop handling KV-cache merging under burst traffic, which caused delayed writeouts to the streaming proxy.
- Workaround deployed at 08:36: rolled back an experimental kernel optimization that increases per-request CPU variance.
- Telemetry: token-serving latency 95th percentile improved from ~1.8s/token to ~0.6s/token after rollback and proxy scaling.

Next steps: we’ll run a controlled canary of a hardened kernel selection patch and follow up with a postmortem. Marissa, please share customer-visible metrics so Rafael can update Oregon Retail.

— Aditya
Principal Engineer, Runtime

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@oregonretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Liam — quick update: our SRE and runtime teams rolled a short-term mitigation (scaled proxies + rollback of an experimental kernel change). Early telemetry shows the 95th latency for token delivery dropped significantly; we expect error rates to return to baseline within the hour.

Temporary recommendations for you:
1) If you can switch critical checkout flows to the synchronous endpoint for 20–40 minutes while we validate metrics, do that (we can automate routing on our side if you prefer).
2) If you must remain on streaming, please disable aggressive frontend reconnect backoffs for 5 minutes so we don't create retry storms.

I’m looping in Jonas (SVP Product) as this had exec visibility — we’ll confirm whether a credited remediation or short-term SLA concession is appropriate depending on the RM impact.

I’ll send a concise incident summary and timeline in ~2 hours.

Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Thanks for the fast work. A few asks for the incident summary:
- Please include clear customer impact (estimated conversion delta or error volume) and timestamped decision points.
- Any rollback/patches we plan to ship, and the ETA for a full rollout.
- Suggest a credit amount if we need to offer remediation (prefer conservative estimate + follow-up after postmortem).

Marissa/Aditya — prioritize the kernel selector postmortem and provide a plan to prevent proxy saturation during short surges (autoscaling policy + conservative kernel opt gating).

Jonas
SVP, Product | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@oregonretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@oregonretail.com, SRE Team <sre@oregonretail.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang on live checkout widgets (high impact)

Rafael / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We followed your recommendation to route the sensitive checkout flows to sync endpoints for 30 minutes and the visible customer impact dropped immediately. Our ops number shows failed assist interactions down 92% during the mitigation window.

We appreciate the rapid response and the interim routing support. Please send the postmortem and the plan for preventing recurrence — we’ll need this for our Q4 ops review.

Best,
Liam
Head of Product, Oregon Retail
